fixture: css-animation




























Scrubbing works by keeping animation-play-state: paused and setting a negative
animation-delay. At progress p the element renders exactly the keyframe at
p x duration, so a frame captured at p=0.5 today matches one captured at
p=0.5 on any other machine.




Lane A moves 540 px over 4 s, so at p the dot's left edge sits at
40 + 540p CSS px. Lane B must land on the same x through a completely
different code path — if A moves and B does not, the OSR surface is only receiving
compositor updates and is missing layout-driven repaints.
